chapter: Funeral customs, Pickwick band and later years
title: The Excelsior and Pickwick brass bands
summary: Allen asks about the Excelsior band, and Love says it came after the Pickwick band went out of existence.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Say, you said there was no Excelsior at one time? No Excelsior brass band?

Not when they had the Pequik band there was no Excelsior. But after the Excelsior went out of existence, then they had, after the Pequik went out of existence, then they had the Excelsior band. That was just as good, you know, almost. Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm .
